title: Impulsive causes; ends; object of petition
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): What we ask for stands as personal (for ourselves and others) or real (spiritual and temporal goods). Ask in Christ's name; God alone stands as toward be religiously adored. — IV. Three impulsive causes: God's will, our need, and ye examples belonging toward Christ and ye saints. Ye end: God's glory, union and communion with God, increase belonging toward faith.
pass_b_english: IV. Three impulsive causes: God's will, our need, and the examples of Christ and the saints. The end: God's glory, union and communion with God, increase of faith.
What we ask for is personal (for ourselves and others) or real (spiritual and temporal goods). Ask in Christ's name; God alone is to be religiously adored.
source_text: IV. Causae impulsivae tres: voluntas Dei, necessitas nostra, exempla Christi sanctorumque. Finis: gloria Dei, unio et communio cum Deo, incrementum fidei. Objectum petitionum personale (pro nobis et aliis) aut reale (bona spiritualia et temporalia). Petendum in nomine Christi; solus Deus religiose adorandus.
